reason: I already pay AngelSense every month and I know what that costs me. This asks for $249 up front plus $19.99 a month on top, and I have no reason yet to believe the live video will connect when Dad is wandering at 2 a.m. I would want to see it work before I sign anything.
objection: Will the video actually connect in a real emergency? If I press the button and it spins, or the signal drops in a parking garage, I have paid for a camera that failed me.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or a money-back window where I can test live video and SOS on Dad's own walks, plus a clear answer on how it works where cell coverage is weak.
